report: The patient has lifelong autism features: poor eye contact, repetitive movements, routine insistence, aggression, hyperactivity, microcephaly, IQ 25, meeting autism with profound ID criteria. Radiologist affirms this phenotype. MRI white matter changes, retinopathy, and cardiac defects suggest an underlying genetic/metabolic or infectious etiology but do not change the behavioral diagnosis. Thus autism with profound ID is most likely.
